skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Gain insight into the working environment of businesses, particularly in the field of computer science.
Develop the ability to analyze and evaluate solutions, and propose improvements.
Build professional relationships with businesses through internships and projects.
Apply theoretical knowledge to solve practical problems in a business setting.
Install and configure software and hardware systems based on business requirements.
Use IT tools and software to perform tasks and install business software.
Adjust system settings based on specific requirements and evaluate business products.
Work effectively in teams to complete assigned tasks and projects.
Engage in discussions, ask and answer questions, and present ideas confidently.
Execute and manage projects assigned by instructors or businesses.
